title: जिसे श्रीराम मारना नहीं चाहते थे | रामायण भाग 5

scenes.narration: श्रीराम का पहला शत्रु — एक राक्षसी, जिसमें हज़ार हाथियों का बल था। पर राम उसे मारना नहीं चाहते थे।
scenes.visual: a huge solid black shadow silhouette of a rakshasi with wild flowing hair and glinting fangs, only two arms, no facial detail, not a goddess, no crown, no extra arms, no wings, no horns, not a dragon, not a gargoyle, looming between the trees of a dark tangled ancient Indian forest at twilight, and small in the foreground a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder, with his back to the viewer, facing her, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: विश्वामित्र दोनों राजकुमारों को नाव से गंगा पार ले चले। बीच धारा में लहरें गरज रही थीं।
scenes.visual: the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff, seated in a small wooden boat crossing a wide river with churning roaring waves, with a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder and a teenage prince Lakshmana about fourteen, fair complexion, alert eyes, simple dhoti, carrying a bow and quiver in the boat, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: उस पार था एक भयानक वन। ऋषि बोले — कभी यहाँ मलद और करूष नाम के समृद्ध जनपद थे।
scenes.visual: landscape only, no people: a dreadful dark forest with twisted thorny trees, eyes of wild animals glinting in the shadows, ruins of ancient Indian village houses with stone walls overgrown by vines, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: फिर ताटका नाम की एक यक्षिणी ने सब उजाड़ दिया। आज भी कोई इधर आने का साहस नहीं करता।
scenes.visual: landscape only, absolutely no people and no figures: a wasted barren land with cracked earth and broken ancient Indian thatched huts under a dark stormy sky, a long dark shadow with wild flowing hair stretched across the cracked ground, ancient Indian setting, no wings, no horns, no domes, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: राम को आश्चर्य हुआ — एक यक्षिणी में इतना बल कैसे?
scenes.visual: a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder, looking up at the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff, who is speaking and gesturing, with a teenage prince Lakshmana about fourteen, fair complexion, alert eyes, simple dhoti, carrying a bow and quiver listening, on a forest path, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: ऋषि ने बताया — ये स्वयं ब्रह्मा जी का वरदान था।
scenes.visual: a radiant lotus of golden light glowing in the night sky, a beam of light descending onto a small yaksha girl in ancient Indian dress with folded hands, faint chalk outlines of many elephants around her, no deity figure, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: पर जब उसने अपने पुत्र मारीच के साथ अगस्त्य ऋषि पर हमला किया, तो उनके शाप से वो नरभक्षी राक्षसी बन गई।
scenes.visual: the sage Agastya, a short sturdy elderly sage with a white beard and a topknot, saffron cloth over one shoulder, holding a kamandalu water pot, raising one hand in a curse with a fierce glow around his palm, before him two large dark shadowy figures with wild hair recoiling, a rakshasi and her son, ancient Indian setting, no wings, no horns, no domes, ancient Indian forest hermitage, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: प्रजा की रक्षा के लिए, काम क्रूर हो या न हो, उसमें पाप हो या दोष, रक्षक को करना ही पड़ता है। यही सनातन राजधर्म है।
तब राम ने धनुष की डोरी टंकारी। पूरा वन काँप उठा, और ताटका गरजती हुई दौड़ी।
scenes.visual: a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder, drawing his bowstring, rings of sound rippling out through a dark forest, birds scattering from the trees, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: फिर भी राम ने लक्ष्मण से कहा — मैं इसे मार नहीं सकता, ये एक स्त्री है। मैं बस इसे रोकूँगा।
scenes.visual: a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder, with his back to the viewer and his face not visible, lowering his bow slightly, standing beside a teenage prince Lakshmana about fourteen, fair complexion, alert eyes, simple dhoti, carrying a bow and quiver, both looking toward a huge dark shadow with wild flowing hair between distant trees, ancient Indian setting, no wings, no horns, no domes, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: ताटका ने धूल का तूफ़ान उठाया, पत्थरों की वर्षा की, और माया से अदृश्य हो गई।
scenes.visual: a raging storm of dust and boulders raining down from a dark sky over a forest clearing, inside the dust a huge shadowy rakshasi silhouette with wild flowing hair dissolving into the haze, two small princes shielding themselves, ancient Indian setting, no wings, no horns, no domes, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: ऋषि गरजे — बस करो ये दया, राम! साँझ होने को है, तब राक्षस और बलवान हो जाते हैं। राम ने केवल आवाज़ सुनकर निशाना साधा, और एक ही बाण से ताटका गिर पड़ी।

scenes.narration: देवताओं ने जयकार किया, और शापित वन फिर से खिल उठा। अगली सुबह, विश्वामित्र के पास राम के लिए एक उपहार था — दिव्य अस्त्र।
